_comment: Reference catalogue. Every other locale must define the same key set; internal/i18n.Load fails at startup otherwise, and the parity test enforces it.
rflag.opt.invalid.name: Invalid
rflag.opt.invalid.help: Hide this realm from the client's realm list entirely.
rflag.opt.build.name: Show build
rflag.opt.build.help: Append the client build to the realm name.
rflag.opt.newPlayers.name: New players
rflag.opt.newPlayers.help: Mark the realm as recommended for new players.
rflag.opt.recommended.name: Recommended
home.lead: Create an account, manage your characters and keep an eye on your account from the browser. The same credentials work in the game client.
login.title: Sign in
login.hint: Use the same account name and password as the game client.
reg.title: Create account
reg.accountHint: 3–16 characters: letters, digits, underscore, dash. Not case sensitive.
reg.passwordHint: At least %d and at most 16 characters. The game client only accepts 16.
panel.noCharacters: You have not created any characters yet. Log into the game to make one.
panel.disabledBanner: This account is disabled and cannot log into the game.
chars.title: My characters
chars.name: Name
chars.confirmUnstick: Move %s back to its home location?
chars.unstickHelp: Unstick moves a character that is stuck in terrain back to its homebind (inn) location. It only works while the character is offline: the server keeps a logged-in character in memory and would save its old position again on logout.
passwd.title: Change password
passwd.hint: The new password applies to both the game client and this site. All other browser sessions are signed out.
sec.title: Two-factor authentication
sec.statusHint: When enabled, the game client asks for a six digit code from your authenticator app every time you log in. The first successful login from an address is remembered for 30 days.
sec.step1: 1. Add this secret to your authenticator app:
sec.orOpen: Or open this link on the device that runs the app:
sec.step2: 2. Enter the current code to activate it:
sec.confirmWithCode: Confirm with a current code from your app.
sec.turnOnHint: You need an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, Aegis, …). The code is standard TOTP over SHA-1 with a 30 second window, which the server accepts with one step of clock drift.
sec.noTrusted: No address is currently trusted; every login asks for a code.
sess.title: Active sessions
sess.confirmAll: Sign out every session, including this one?
sess.hint: Sessions last %d hours. Changing your password or an administrator resetting it signs every session out.
admin.title: Administration
admin.name: Name
admin.realmNote: icon and timezone are overwritten by mangosd from GameType/RealmZone on every start, so they are edited in mangosd.conf.
acct.title: Accounts
acct.rankHint: You can only grant ranks up to your own (%s).
acct.selfNote: This is your own account; self-destructive actions are disabled.
acct.disabledNote: This account is disabled and cannot log in.
acct.disableNote: Disabling blocks the game login (realmd rejects inactive accounts) without deleting anything. It is the reversible alternative to deletion.
acct.noBans: No bans recorded for this account.
acct.durationHint: Hours. Use 0 for a permanent ban.
acct.banNote: A ban is written exactly like the in-game ban account command (account_banned, permanent when unbandate equals bandate). It is enforced by realmd/worldmgr on the next login; a player already in game stays connected because this service cannot reach the world server.
acct.confirmResetPassword: Reset the password of %s? All their sessions are signed out.
acct.twoFaRecoveryHint: Use this when a player lost their authenticator device. The secret is cleared and the account can log in again without a code.
acct.deleteNote: Deletes the account, every character on it and all related rows. Characters must be offline. A character that leads a guild must be handled first, because disbanding a guild from here would desynchronise the running world server.
acct.confirmDeleteText: This permanently deletes the account and ALL its characters. Continue?
achar.title: Characters
achar.detail.positionNote: Moving a character writes the homebind position from character_homebind. It only works offline, because the world server overwrites the row with its in-memory position on logout.
achar.detail.disabledOnline: Disabled while the character is online.
achar.detail.confirmRename: Force %s to rename on next login?
achar.detail.renameNote: Applies at_login |= RENAME; the client prompts for a new name at next login.
achar.detail.levelNote: Setting a level bypasses the normal progression and is not reversible; the character keeps its spells and talents.
bans.title: Bans
bans.ipNote: Stored in ip_banned. A duration of 0 is permanent. The world server reads this table on startup and periodically.
realm.title: Realms
realm.intro: realmlist is what the login server hands to the client. The id must match RealmID in mangosd.conf and port must match WorldServerPort — not the realmd login port.
realm.heading: Realm
realm.name: Name
realm.addressHint: The address clients connect to for the world server.
realm.offlineNote: The offline bit is written by mangosd, so it is not offered here.
realm.accessNote: Accounts below this rank see the realm as locked. Useful for maintenance windows.
realm.buildsNote: written by mangosd, never read back
realm.empty: No realm rows exist yet. Create one so the login server can advertise this world:
audit.title: Audit log
audit.hint: The 200 most recent administrative actions, newest first.
err.title: Something went wrong
err.hint: If this keeps happening, contact the server administrator.
err.rankTooLow: Your account rank is too low to open the administration area.
err.serverErrorHint: Something went wrong. The error has been logged.
flash.welcome: Welcome, %s! Your account is ready - you can log into the game now.
flash.registerClosed: Self-registration is disabled on this server.
flash.err.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
flash.err.usernameShort: Account names must be at least %d characters.
flash.err.usernameChars: Account names may only contain letters, digits, underscore and dash.
flash.err.usernameLong: Account names may be at most 16 characters.
flash.err.passwordLong: Passwords may be at most 16 characters.
flash.err.passwordShort: Passwords must be at least %d characters.
flash.err.passwordSame: The password must be different from the account name.
flash.err.emailInvalid: That email address does not look valid.
flash.err.accountLimit: This server has reached its account limit.
flash.err.nameTaken: That account name is already taken.
flash.err.accountDisabled: This account has been disabled. Please contact an administrator.
flash.err.currentPassword: The current password is not correct.
flash.err.newPasswordSame: The new password must be different from the current one.
flash.err.invalidCode: That authenticator code is not valid.
flash.err.invalidCodeRetry: That code is not valid. Check that your device clock is correct and try the next code.
flash.err.setupExpired: The setup has expired. Please start again.
flash.err.characterOnline: That character is currently logged in. Log out first, then try again.
flash.err.unstickFailed: Could not move the character. Please contact an administrator.
flash.err.revokeFailed: Could not remove that trusted address.
flash.err.ownRank: You cannot change your own rank.
flash.err.grantHigher: You cannot grant a rank higher than your own.
flash.err.createHigher: You cannot create an account with a higher rank than your own.
flash.err.ownDisable: You cannot disable your own account.
flash.err.ownBan: You cannot ban your own account.
flash.err.banHigher: You cannot ban an account with an equal or higher rank.
flash.err.ownDelete: You cannot delete your own account.
flash.err.deleteHigher: You cannot delete an account with an equal or higher rank.
flash.err.confirmName: To confirm deletion, type the account name exactly.
flash.err.badDuration: Invalid ban duration. Use a number of hours, or 0 for a permanent ban.
flash.err.charsOnline: That account still has a character online.
flash.err.reset2faHigher: You cannot reset the authenticator of an account with an equal or higher rank.
flash.err.badIP: That is not a valid IP address.
flash.err.ownIP: Refusing to ban the address you are connected from.
flash.err.realmEmpty: Name and address must not be empty.
flash.err.realmNameTaken: Another realm already uses that name.
flash.err.characterOnlineAdmin: That character is online. The world server would overwrite the position on logout, so log the character out first.
flash.err.namesOnly: Account names may only contain letters, digits, underscore and dash.
flash.ok.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Use it the next time you log in.
flash.ok.unstuck: %s has been moved back to its home location.
flash.ok.unstickQueued: %s has been moved back to its home location.
flash.ok.twoFaOn: Two-factor authentication is active. You will be asked for a code when you log into the game.
flash.ok.trustedRemoved: The trusted address has been removed; the next login from it will ask for a code.
flash.ok.othersSignedOut: All other sessions have been signed out.
flash.ok.allSignedOut: All sessions have been signed out, including this one.
flash.ok.accountDisabled: %s has been disabled and can no longer log in.
flash.ok.banned: %s has been banned. The ban applies from the next login; a player already in game stays connected.
flash.ok.unbanned: All bans for %s have been lifted.
flash.ok.passwordReset: Password for %s has been reset. Tell the player to change it after logging in.
flash.ok.twoFaReset: The authenticator of %s has been removed. They can log in without a code and set up a new device.
flash.ok.accountDeleted: Account %s and its %d characters have been deleted.
flash.ok.renameQueued: %s will be asked to pick a new name the next time it logs in.
flash.ok.flagApplied: %s %s for %s; it takes effect on the next login.
flash.ok.ipUnbanned: The ban on %s has been removed.
flash.ok.realmUpdated: Realm updated. Clients pick the change up on their next realm list refresh.
flash.ok.realmOpen: The realm is open to every account.
flash.ok.realmRestricted: Only accounts of rank %d (%s) or higher may enter.
ann.title: Login announcement
ann.intro: This is the notice the game client shows on the left of its login screen, in the "Server Alert" panel. It is fetched by the client itself, so it appears before anyone logs in.
ann.enabledHint: When off, the panel is served empty so nothing is displayed.
ann.titleHint: The panel's heading comes from the client, so this is only used to label the notice here in the panel.
ann.bodyHint: Plain text. Blank lines separate paragraphs; single line breaks are kept. Maximum 20000 characters.
ann.never: This announcement has never been saved.
ann.previewHint: The client renders this with a cut-down HTML widget, so it is plain text only: no colours, images or links.
ann.empty: Nothing is being served: the announcement is either empty or switched off.
ann.howClient: The game client requests the address above when it draws the login screen. It is a one-way fetch: the client sends no session and expects no cookies.
ann.howPatch: That address is baked into a small client patch (patch-Z.mpq), which overrides the value shipped in the translation pack. Only change it when the site moves.
ann.howDisabled: Editing here takes effect on the next login screen. No server restart and no client patch are needed.
home.signInForStatus: Sign in to see the realm's status and how to connect.
flash.err.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts from here. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
ann.tooLong: This announcement is longer than the game client can display; the end will be cut off. Shorten it.
notice.title: Login notice
notice.intro: The game client also shows this notice on its login screen.
notice.empty: There is no notice at the moment.
notice.linkHint: Put the details address on a line of its own and the login screen renders it as a link you can click.
reason.nextHint: If that does not explain it, contact the server's administrator and quote the line the client showed you.
reason.banned.title: This account is banned
reason.banned.body: A banned account cannot sign in. Bans are applied by an administrator, most often for cheating software or automation, for trading accounts or gold, or for sustained harassment in public channels.
reason.banned.todo: A ban does not expire on its own. If you believe it is a mistake, contact an administrator; the notice page carries whatever the server has announced.
reason.suspended.title: This account is suspended
reason.suspended.body: A suspension is temporary and lifts by itself, with nothing for you to do. There are two common causes: a timed penalty, and an account that locks sign-in to known locations while you are connecting from one that is not on the list yet.
reason.suspended.todo: If it is the location lock, enabling two-factor authentication (or setting a fixed PIN) in the account security settings lets you sign in from the new location.
reason.no-time.title: This account is out of credit
reason.no-time.body: The account's shop balance has gone negative, so sign-in is refused. This usually follows a refund, a reversed order, or a manual adjustment that took the balance below zero.
reason.no-time.todo: Contact an administrator to go over the balance. Sign-in stays refused until it is settled.
reason.verify.title: The e-mail is not verified yet
reason.verify.body: This server requires a verified e-mail address before sign-in, and the confirmation link was sent to the address the account was registered with.
reason.verify.todo: Open the confirmation mail in your inbox. If it never arrived, check the spam folder first, then ask an administrator to send it again.
shop.title: Donation shop
shop.reloadHint: The world server loads both tables into memory at startup. Run `.reload shop` in its console to pick up a change here; no restart is needed.
shop.search: Search by item name or entry
shop.warn.otherRegionHint: When the region does not match, the world server skips the row at startup and players never see it in the shop.
shop.item.title: Shop entry
shop.item.entryHint: What the player receives. It has to exist in that table or the world server drops the row at startup.
shop.item.missing: No such entry in item_template - the world server will skip this row at startup.
shop.item.categoryHint: The category has to exist in shop_categories, or the row is skipped as well.
shop.item.priceHint: The unit is shop coins. **Zero is not allowed**: the world server skips entries priced at 0.
shop.item.regionHint: An entry whose region does not match this realm never appears in the shop.
shop.item.displayIdHint: Leave both at 0 to use the item's own look.
shop.item.textHint: ⚠ The world server reads these into memory and then never uses them: the name and description the client shows come from item_template. Editing them changes nothing in game.
shop.item.deleteHint: Removes this shop listing only. Player items and item_template are untouched.
shop.err.noCategory: That category does not exist in shop_categories - the world server would skip this row.
shop.err.noItem: item_template has no such entry - the world server would skip this row.
shop.err.duplicateEntry: This item is already sold by entry #%d. One item may only appear once; the world server skips the duplicate.
shop.warn.otherRegion: This row is locked to %s while this realm is %s, so players never see it in the shop.
shop.warn.scaleZero: A scale of 0 makes the model invisible; use 1 for the default.
shop.flash.created: Created a shop entry for item %d.
shop.flash.updated: Saved the shop entry for item %d.
shop.flash.deleted: Deleted the shop entry for item %d.
shop.item.categoryMissing: that category is not in shop_categories (the world server skips this row at startup)
shop.cat.title: Shop categories
shop.cat.idHint: Leave empty to let the database assign one. The core reads the id as a single byte (uint8), so it has to be 1-255, and the client orders the tabs by it - give a category a smaller id to move it earlier. It cannot be changed afterwards: the items point at it.
shop.cat.name: Name (English)
shop.cat.nameHint: Shown on a realm that is not the Chinese one. It cannot contain '=' or ';': the world server builds the whole category list for the client as one string out of those two characters, and a single one of them shifts every category.
shop.cat.nameCnHint: Shown on a Chinese realm (NiHao=1); falls back to the English name when empty.
shop.cat.iconHint: The client builds Interface\ShopFrame\<icon>.blp from this, so it has to be a texture that really exists. The suggestions below are the named icons the client ships; you may point it at artwork of your own added to a patch, but a name with no file behind it leaves the tab blank.
shop.cat.iconUnknown: the client may not have this icon
shop.cat.aboutHint: The About tab is not in this table - the client inserts it itself. See tools/ClientPatch for changing its text.
shop.cat.err.nameRequired: Fill in at least one name (English or Chinese).
shop.cat.err.separators: A name or an icon cannot contain '=' or ';'. The world server joins the whole category list with them, and one of them shifts every category.
shop.cat.err.idRange: The id has to be 1-255 (the core reads it as a single byte).
shop.cat.err.inUse: %d items still point at this category, so nothing was deleted. The world server skips every item whose category is missing - move them to another category first.
shop.cat.warn.iconUnknown: This name is not among the icons the client ships - unless you added Interface\ShopFrame\<name>.blp to a patch yourself, the tab will show no icon.
shop.cat.warn.duplicateName: Another category already uses this name; the two tabs will be impossible to tell apart.
shop.cat.deleteHint: Removes the category only. Nothing points at it, so the shop's contents are unaffected.
shop.cat.deleteBlocked: items still use this category, so deleting it is refused. The world server skips every item whose category is missing, so deleting it would make them disappear from the shop.
shop.cat.deleteBlockedLink: Show the items in this category and move them to another one first.
shop.cat.err.nameForRealm: This realm is the Chinese one (NiHao=1), so the world server only sends the Chinese name to the client. Left empty, the client cannot parse the row and the category does not appear at all - it is not shown blank. The same applies to the English name on a European realm.
shop.cat.warn.otherNameEmpty: The other language's name is empty. That is fine now, but flipping this realm to the other region (NiHao reversed) would make the client skip the category entirely - filling in both is safer.
